question: Who among the following envoys was sent by Seleucus I to the court of Chandragupta Maurya?
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 4**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Megasthenes** was the envoy sent by Seleucus I to the court of Chandragupta Maurya.
 
• Megasthenes was a Greek historian and diplomat who authored the work **Indica**, which provides valuable information about Mauryan India.
 
• His observations and accounts are considered one of the earliest Western accounts of India.
 
• Megasthenes’ work offers insights into the administration, society, and culture of the Mauryan period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Seleucus I Nicator** was one of the generals of Alexander the Great and later founded the Seleucid Empire.
 
• After Alexander's death, Seleucus established control over a vast territory that included parts of the Middle East and Asia.
 
• The alliance and diplomatic relationship between Seleucus and Chandragupta Maurya were significant in shaping the geopolitical landscape of the time.
 
• The **Indica** by Megasthenes, though lost in its original form, survives through quotations by later authors such as Strabo and Arrian.
